fusions.name: Steel Quill
fusions.desc: Throws a steel quill that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at 5 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Blunted] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Falling Weight
fusions.desc: You drop out of a leap in full plate, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lift Clear
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Featherweight Harness
fusions.desc: You move 8% faster, and your physical resistance rises by 6%.
